caption: The drawing depicts a log cabin with a slanted roof and a chimney on the left side, constructed with horizontal logs in shades of pink and light brown. A flag, which is also pink and features a cross design, flies from a pole attached to the roof. In front of the cabin, two human figures are present; one is dressed in pink trousers and a white shirt with brown suspenders, while the other figure is clad in greenish clothing and a hat, with what appears to be a peg leg. They appear to be interacting or shaking hands. Surrounding the log cabin is a grassy area with patches of green and pink, and small plants or bushes in the foreground. To the left, a duck or goose is visible near the edge of the grassy area. Behind the figures and the cabin, there is a body of water with horizontal lines representing its surface. In the background, hills or low mountains appear in pink, and the sun is depicted as a yellow circle with radiating rays, partially rising or setting behind the hills. Some trees, including a prominent green one on the left, add to the background elements. The overall color palette of the drawing consists primarily of subdued shades of pink, green, yellow, and brown. The composition is contained within an oval shape, centered on a cream-colored rectangular sheet.
title: Wallpaper from Bandbox
